note: What a server sends to put a unit that belongs to no side on the field. In everything observed it arrives only inside EnterSight, and the channel and delivery recorded here are those of the message carrying it.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: The name the unit answers to, so later messages can name it.

fields.name: node
fields.note: Which network node the object belongs to. A client reads it apart from the name beside it rather than as that name's leading byte.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where the unit stands, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: atY
fields.note: Where the unit stands, in height, in world units.

fields.name: atZ
fields.note: Where the unit stands, along the other ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: campAtX
fields.note: Where the camp it belongs to sits, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: campAtY
fields.note: Where the camp it belongs to sits, in height, in world units.

fields.name: campAtZ
fields.note: Where the camp it belongs to sits, along the other ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: facingX
fields.note: A point the unit faces toward, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: facingY
fields.note: That point, in height.

fields.name: facingZ
fields.note: That point, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: name
fields.note: What this unit is called, so a client can tell one from another. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.

fields.name: asset
fields.note: The name the client loads its art and sound under, written and padded as above.

fields.name: uniqueName
fields.note: A further name the unit answers to, written and padded as above.

fields.name: spawnAnimation
fields.note: The name the client loads what it does on arriving under, written and padded as above.

fields.name: side
fields.note: The side it belongs to, or zero where it belongs to none.

fields.name: damageBonus
fields.note: What is added to the damage it deals.

fields.name: healthBonus
fields.note: What is added to the health it holds.

fields.name: roaming
fields.note: How far the unit wanders from its camp. What the figure counts is not recorded here.

fields.name: camp
fields.note: Which camp it belongs to.

fields.name: effectSide
fields.note: The side that gains what killing it grants.

fields.name: revealEvent
fields.note: What makes the unit known to a side that cannot see it. It is 74 for every camp observed but one, which carries 43.

fields.name: level
fields.note: The level it starts at.

fields.name: spawnDuration
fields.note: How long its arrival takes, in seconds.

fields.name: spawnAt
fields.note: When it arrives, in seconds.

fields.name: behaviour
fields.note: Which set of doings the unit follows.

fields.name: script
fields.note: The name the client loads those doings under, written and padded as above.
